name: System Design 101
summary: Open-source repo of 300+ illustrated system design explainers: APIs, databases, caching, payments and company architectures.
description: A collection of visual explainers that break complex systems into diagrams and simple terms, grouped into twelve sections: API and web development, real-world case studies (Figma, Netflix, Uber, Airbnb, Discord, TikTok, Slack …), AI and machine learning, databases and storage, technical interviews, caching and performance, payments and fintech, software architecture, dev tools and productivity, software development, cloud and distributed systems, and how-it-works posts.

12 sections: API, case studies, AI/ML, databases, interviews, caching, payments, architecture …
